description: Public gameplay inventory decisions. Pending means unfinished, not excluded. Related executable scenarios are evidence candidates, not member-level conformance claims. Pure library checks cannot establish native gameplay support.

mineflayer.createBot.reason: The BB thread is already attached to a native body; server connections and account authentication are outside the agreed scope.

mineflayer.Bot.connect.reason: Network connection setup is outside the agreed native-body API scope.

mineflayer.Bot._client.reason: Mineflayer's internal packet client is outside the agreed public gameplay compatibility boundary.

evidencePolicy.results: not-recorded means executable indexed without a durable run; passed is accepted only when scenario/report hashes verify. Missing ignored reports remain unverified, not passes.
evidencePolicy.levels: library-differential and serialization are distinct from runtime-boundary, native-integration and live-reference.
evidencePolicy.supported: Requires verified passing native-integration and live-reference evidence. All current native requirements remain pending.
evidencePolicy.referenceServer: No live reference run is recorded; Minecraft EULA acceptance remains unanswered.
evidencePolicy.nativeRuns: Historical source-matched native reports are indexed with their limitations and tested revisions where available. They do not validate newer code or establish paired reference conformance.

block-library.scope: Pinned Block/state/harvest/dig/sign scenarios in QuickJS; does not verify native observations.

item-library.scope: Pinned Item registry/component/NBT/anvil scenarios in QuickJS; no native inventory claim.

item-wire.scope: Source-derived wire fixtures and transport checks. Native Java byte probes are separate evidence; do not infer a live reference comparison.

window-library.scope: Window layouts/queries/clicks/events in QuickJS; named upstream corrections checked separately. No authoritative native click proof.

raycast-library.scope: Synthetic typed Block lookup with actual goals, clipping corrections and bounds in QuickJS; not native visibility.

movements-library.scope: Deterministic movement/planner fixtures against upstream; no native movement execution proof.

planning-library.scope: Source/library planning and goal scenarios; no claim that every goal or option is exercised.

runtime-boundary.scope: Worker isolation, awaited bridge operations, cancellation and execution/output bounds; not gameplay conformance.

native-block-observations.scope: Requires known slab/sign/ore fixture and independent native world observations. Availability is not a passing run.

native-item-observations.scope: Requires actual native damaged/component stacks and independently decoded native bytes. Availability is not a passing run.

native-window-observations.scope: Window/item identity, slot queries and equipment; does not exercise container mutations.
native-window-observations.limitations: Native scripted assertions only; no paired live-reference run or full surface conformance.
native-window-observations.independentObservation: No separate independent observation section in this report; do not infer one.

native-raycast-observations.scope: Slab hit and goal visibility against native cache; requires fixture.
native-raycast-observations.limitations: Native scripted assertions only; no paired live-reference run or full surface conformance.
native-raycast-observations.independentObservation: No separate independent observation section in this report; do not infer one.

native-event-observations.scope: Independent fixture mutation, blockUpdate, physicsTick and stable entity identity. Availability is not a passing run.

native-tick-order.scope: Tick count and state visible before action completion. Availability is not a passing run.

native-navigation-policy.scope: Requires wall/body fixture; checks planned policy and native arrival.
native-navigation-policy.limitations: Narrow native slice only; no paired live-reference run. Shortcut/free motion/partial execution/custom physics/large loaded caches and other API conditions remain pending.
native-navigation-policy.independentObservation: report.independent includes final native route state

native-navigation-lifecycle.scope: No-path, changed goal and stopping scenario; execution integration remains pending.
native-navigation-lifecycle.limitations: Narrow native slice only; no paired live-reference run. Shortcut/free motion/partial execution/custom physics/large loaded caches and other API conditions remain pending.
native-navigation-lifecycle.independentObservation: No separate independent observation section in this report; do not infer one.

native-gather.scope: Shared gather procedure; needs a native fixture/harness and independent ore/inventory checks. Availability is not a passing run.

reference-gather.scope: Server harness for gather.js with independent server checks. Not run; requires explicit EULA acceptance. Catalog generation never invokes it.

native-navigation-shapes.scope: Native slab/full-block step, jump and drop assertions. Does not cover shortcut/free motion/partial execution/custom physics/large loaded caches.
native-navigation-shapes.limitations: Narrow native slice only; no paired live-reference run. Shortcut/free motion/partial execution/custom physics/large loaded caches and other API conditions remain pending.
native-navigation-shapes.independentObservation: No separate independent observation section in this report; do not infer one.

native-consume-sign-game.scope: Potion/milk effects and authoritative remainders, sign editing, dismount and player/game snapshots. No broad gameplay or multiplayer claim.
native-consume-sign-game.limitations: Historical packaged run; not a run of current HEAD, not paired live-reference or exhaustive member conformance. Independent summary is retained in report.independentSummary.

native-fishing-catch.scope: One natural catch: salmon, native rod durability/XP, hook removal and twenty healthy subsequent ticks. No statistical loot or every cancellation claim.
native-fishing-catch.limitations: Historical packaged run; not a run of current HEAD, not paired live-reference or exhaustive member conformance. Independent summary is retained in report.independentSummary.

native-boat-controls.scope: Existing boat forward/turn/coast/control clearing/dismount. Initial fixture already mounted; does not prove a new mount event. Native Mob may reboard after cooldown.
native-boat-controls.limitations: Historical packaged run; not a run of current HEAD, not paired live-reference or exhaustive member conformance. Independent summary is retained in report.independentSummary.

native-bed-sleep.scope: Actual native sleeping state, occupied bed halves and hydrated callbacks; retained after script release. No player night skipping/respawn claim.
native-bed-sleep.limitations: Historical packaged run; not a run of current HEAD, not paired live-reference or exhaustive member conformance. Independent summary is retained in report.independentSummary.

native-bed-wake.scope: Wake callbacks/native occupancy, unchanged inventory and AlreadyAwake rejection. Wider permissions/lifecycle cases untested.
native-bed-wake.limitations: Historical packaged run; not a run of current HEAD, not paired live-reference or exhaustive member conformance. Independent summary is retained in report.independentSummary.

native-observation-events.scope: Crouch/uncrouch, one native effect add/removal, stable identities during countdown and look-only move event. No arbitrary event/amplifier refresh claim.
native-observation-events.limitations: Historical packaged run; not a run of current HEAD, not paired live-reference or exhaustive member conformance. Independent summary is retained in report.independentSummary.

reviewNotes.prismarine-item.Item: Components/componentMap/removedComponents are source-visible but omitted from declarations; Item.equal ignores components in the pin.
reviewNotes.prismarine-windows.Window: Declarations/docs/runtime disagree on some signatures, layouts and events; windows.mjs separates intended corrections from parity. Drag/double-click throw upstream.
reviewNotes.prismarine-world.WorldSync: Synchronous getBlock/raycast and numeric getters/events are implemented. Only raycast has library evidence; runtime additions await native verification. Full columns/async storage/client-cache mutation semantics remain pending.
reviewNotes.mineflayer-pathfinder.Pathfinder: Undeclared source settings include searchRadius, enablePathShortcut and LOSWhenPlacingBlocks. Selected-route native slices passed; shortcut/free motion/partial execution/custom physics/large loaded cache and other behavior remain pending.
reviewNotes.events.EventEmitter: Inherited instance surface comes from pinned events 3.3.0, not current Node type declarations. Event payloads/ordering need independent native evidence.
reviewNotes.prismarine-registry.loader.RegistryPc: Registry tables and codecs, chunk access/storage, Bedrock-labelled data and source-only helpers require applicability review; none are silently excluded.
reviewNotes.mineflayer-pathfinder.goals.GoalBreakBlo: Pinned declarations extend GoalLookAtBlock, but source extends Goal and wraps this.goal; source isEnd drops its node argument. Inherited declaration promises require review.
reviewNotes.mineflayer.Bot.chatPatterns: Declared public ChatPattern[] in index.d.ts, but pinned chat.js keeps private _patterns and never assigns bot.chatPatterns. Requires an explicit declaration/source decision; do not treat declaration presence as upstream runtime behavior.
